node.statement: Under the respective Stage-3 producer hypotheses, put t=t_3=W.K3*epsilon. Lem-maincb-stage3-call-envelope applies with W.L>=L^0, W.K3>=max{K_3^0,1,W.L,W.c0_cb*W.L}, and W.e_cross<=e_cross^0, and, using lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum, furnishes the explicit amplified Stage-3 four-corner datum in A_R with target ambient record epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon<=t and common defect rho<=C_cross^0*t. The producer smallness epsilon<=W.e_cross/W.K3 gives 0<=t<=W.e_cross, and W.e_cross<=min{e_cross^0,e_3} supplies the receiving condition required by lem-maincb-stage3-raw-merge.
